Specifically, A. Sporicidal agents are not used in the production area. Your firm uses non-sterile wipes and a multi-enzymalic cleanser to clean the production area and utensils. Sporidical agents have never been used, and none are available at your facility. B. Your firm uses non-sterile disinfecting wipes to clean the production area. No sterile wipes intended for cleaning work surfaces were available at your firm. C. The work surface is not disinfected prior to packaging vials into syringes. For example, on 3/25/2025, during the filling of syringes of Tirzepatide/ Cyanocobalamin, ISmg/lmg/mL, Lot# 03065F, BUD: 7/6/2025, from a vial, the operator failed to disinfect the work surfaces with appropriate wipes prior to use.
